originalTitle: Will any manufacturer ship 1 GW or more of perovskite solar modules in a single calendar year by December 31, 2028?
title: 2028 年底前会有制造商实现年度 1 GW 钙钛矿组件出货吗？
Will a manufacturer ship 1 GW of perovskite modules in a year by end-2028?
rules: 单一制造商须在 2026、2027 或 2028 年某一日历年商业交付至少 1000 MW 钙钛矿或钙钛矿／硅叠层组件，且有可获融资认可的质保。研究组件、无相应质保的 BIPV 试点和室内光伏不计。

One manufacturer must commercially ship at least 1,000 MW of perovskite or perovskite/silicon modules in calendar 2026, 2027 or 2028 with bankable warranties. Research modules and unqualified BIPV pilots or indoor PV do not count.
interpretation: 年产能、签约订单与实际出货不同；不能跨制造商或跨年份累加。
Capacity, orders and shipments differ; do not aggregate across manufacturers or years.

summary: 原题要求单一制造商在一个日历年达到商业交付门槛，并保留质保条件，考查的并非实验室效率。
This requires one manufacturer to reach an annual commercial shipment threshold with warranty conditions, rather than a laboratory efficiency record.
checklist: 核对单一制造商与日历年份。
核对已出货组件额定功率与技术类别。
Check shipped rated module power and technology.
查验质保及独立行业统计。
Verify warranties and independent deployment statistics.

impact: Oxford PV 的首批交付说明叠层组件进入商业应用。年度 1 GW 还取决于扩产、良率、质保与客户接收，不能将 MW 级试验线或未来工厂计划直接视为达标。
Oxford PV’s first delivery shows commercial use. Annual 1 GW still depends on scale-up, yield, warranties and customer receipt; MW-scale pilot output or factory plans do not meet the threshold.
gap: 首次出货公告未给出年度 GW 级交付与对应质保证明。
The first-shipment announcement does not establish annual GW-scale delivery and qualifying warranties.

title: 叠层效率、制造产能与实际出货
Tandem efficiency, factory capacity and shipments
principle: 钙钛矿层与硅层吸收不同波段，以提高入射光的利用率。电池效率经过互联、封装和有效面积损失后，才形成组件效率。制造线的额定能力还要经过良率与利用率，才能转为可销售出货。

Perovskite and silicon absorb different spectral bands. Module efficiency includes interconnection, encapsulation and area losses; nameplate factory capacity becomes sales only through yield and utilization.
example: Oxford PV 首批商业组件的 24.5% 效率说明了产品性能，年度 1 GW 则考查累计交付的额定功率。全球多数部署使用哪种材料，还需要统计整个行业的年度装机。
Oxford PV’s first modules had 24.5% efficiency; annual 1 GW concerns cumulative delivered rated power. A global-majority contract needs industry-wide annual deployment data.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
